mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation models and increasing the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in the next 5 days but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative earnings outlook and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate output, which lowers expected earnings and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1500.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), consumer and business confidence is high, leading to increased corporate investment and earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
